title: BACE: Applied Mathematics - BACE - Applied Mathematics - Scientific Notation
subject: BACE - Applied Mathematics

questions.q: Which of the following correctly expresses the number **0.0000458** in scientific notation?
questions.explain: Move the decimal point 5 places to the right to get a number between 1 and 10 ($4.58$). Since the original number was less than 1, the exponent is negative: $4.58 \times 10^{-5}$.
questions.subject: BACE - Applied Mathematics

questions.q: Express the sum of **$2.3 \times 10^{-3}$** and **$1.4 \times 10^{-4}$** in correct scientific notation.
questions.explain: To add, exponents must be the same. Convert $1.4 \times 10^{-4}$ to $0.14 \times 10^{-3}$. $$2.3 \times 10^{-3} + 0.14 \times 10^{-3} = (2.3 + 0.14) \times 10^{-3} = 2.44 \times 10^{-3}$$
questions.subject: BACE - Applied Mathematics

questions.q: Which of the following numbers corresponds to **$6.02 \times 10^4$**?
questions.explain: The exponent is positive 4, so move the decimal point 4 places to the right: $6.02 \rightarrow 60.2 \rightarrow 602 \rightarrow 6020 \rightarrow 60200$.
